acquisition method: washed protein-bound beads were subjected directly to enzymatic digestions, and MudPIT analysis and the collected MS/MS spectra were analyzed as described.
alkylation reagent: Search parameters included the dynamic oxidation of methionine and the static carbamidomethylation of cysteine
cleavage agent: proteins were reduced, alkylated, and digested with LysC and trypsin.
enrichment method: Mass spectrometry of ookinete-secreted proteins isolated using a new chitin bead pull-down method
fractionation method: The trypsin digested proteins products were fractionated using LC-MS/MS.
instrument: The digested peptides were analyzed on an Orbitrap Fusion Mass Spectrometer
ionization type: Nanospray ionization was achieved by applying 2000V through the stainless-steel T and the inlet of the column.
labeling: PgCHT1 and PgCHT2 were identified (spectra counts of 32 and 53 respectively)
reduction reagent: Reduction with DTT eliminated the high molecular mass P. falciparum chitinase-containing complex
